profile.headline: Senior Web Developer at Georgia Institute of  Technology - Scheller College of Business
profile.summary: Seasoned web professional bringing unique perspectives, problem-solving abilities, and a depth of industry knowledge to producing and managing websites. Key strengths are front-end development, user interface/experience (UI/UX), mobile-first approaches, and website and team management. High level of experience developing and managing websites using open-source technology such as Drupal and WordPress, as well as Enterprise CMS’s.

company.name: Georgia Tech Scheller College of Business
Drexel University Dornsife School of Public Health

positions.title: Digital Communications Specialist
positions.description: Oversee Dornsife's website development as well as a range of digital communications activities.

positions.title: Web Interfaces Team Manager
positions.description: I manage the University web portal focusing on user experience improvement, front-end development, user testing and engagement, as well as providing University UX consultancy. My responsibilities also include overseeing a web development service specialising in internal Drupal-based websites/web applications.

positions.title: Senior Services Manager
positions.description: As a member of the Web Integration team, I manage the web-based student portal and mobile experience for the University of Edinburgh. My work focuses on management and improvement of the overall service, front-end development,  and UX.

positions.title: Manager of Web & Online Communications, Global Engagement
